title: Deeper/broader independent ACIS reader and current DWG/DXF peer routes
mode: Primary project-source research and local plan crosswalk
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Expand the open-source DWG/DXF/ACIS peer screen with currently published implementations and issue reports.
Separate parser lineage, geometry-kernel lineage, same-codec round-trip evidence, native-application acceptance, and semantic shape evidence.
Update existing PAR-07/S8 readiness and optional peer-route guidance without adding implementation blockers or promoting support claims.

sources.observed: MIT-licensed and explicitly experimental SAT/SAB parser/converter. The release lists SAT profiles 105/400/600/700 and selected SAB/ASM profiles, a limited analytic geometry conversion subset, experimental NURBS, and explicit raw retention/error for unsupported geometry. The package uses CadQuery/OCCT for shape conversion. Its test corpus is excluded from distributions and has separate license notices; the PyPI publish attestation points to the pinned source commit.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A potential independent parser for only declared profiles, with shared OCCT geometry-kernel lineage. No package was installed or run, and no complete DWG/DXF/AcDs route was qualified.

sources.revision: Published docs.rs crate 0.5.5 dated 2026-09-10; mutable repository and issue index also reviewed 2026-10-19, including reports against 0.6.3/0.6.4
sources.observed: Published documentation claims versioned DWG/DXF read/write, 48 entity variants, SAT/SAB tools, and an entity compatibility atlas. Visible 3D tests include generated/fake payload cases and same-codec reopen assertions. Current issue reports allege malformed-input allocation exhaustion and panic behavior, owner relocation, custom-class/color-book/XDATA loss, merged-table loss, and a recent AC1032 regression. Release, source-head, and issue versions differ.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Potential pinned differential peer only. Claims and issue reports were not independently reproduced; same-codec tests do not prove semantic or target-CAD behavior. Do not run on untrusted data without isolation and exact revision binding.

sources.project: Open CASCADE CAD Assistant / OCCT ACIS component
sources.revision: Official product documentation and OCCT 6.9.0/6.9.1 release notes reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The product page lists SAT/SAB import through commercial XDE components and says model export/conversion is disallowed for data imported by those components. The product page lists macOS Intel and ARM64 installers.
sources.evidenceCeiling: The previously selected official macOS ARM64 application can be a bounded external native-reader observation only after exact product/build capture. This is not an open-source OCCT SAT interface or an independent kernel vote; no application was installed or run.

sources.revision: Mutable project documentation and maintainer discussion reviewed 2026-10-19; discussion dated 2025-05-13
sources.observed: Project documentation lists a bounded set of DXF read/write versions. The maintainer describes ACIS support as basic and cautions that solid authoring does not imply reliable general B-rep semantics. DWG access through ODA File Converter is a distinct converter chain.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Useful for selected DXF syntax and field checks; not a general DWG codec or ACIS semantic oracle. The older broad statement that no open-source ACIS importer exists is now qualified by the newer limited cq-acis release.

sources.observed: The project publishes separate DXF reader/writer and DWG reader/writer version columns, with non-identical support by format and version.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Documentation-level reminder to bind operation/version; no peer build or runtime test was performed.

assessment.planImpact: Adds cq-acis as an optional profile-specific independent-parser semantic candidate with OCCT kernel lineage explicitly disclosed; upgrades ACadRust to an optional pinned differential candidate while documenting its same-codec evidence ceiling and current reported risks; preserves the selected CAD Assistant macOS ARM64 route as optional product-level evidence. No required gate, dependency, support claim, or local queue order changes.

method.kind: Read-only primary project-source web review and local plan reconciliation
method.limitations: Project documentation and issue reports are mutable and mostly self-reported. No external tool behavior was reproduced. cq-acis covers only declared SAT/SAB/ASM profiles and shares OCCT kernel lineage; ACadRust issue reports are not findings against libdxfrw. The user-selected CAD Assistant build remains to be pinned and run.
